content: This is a list of types of medical therapy, including forms of traditional medicine and alternative medicine. For psychotherapies and other behavioral and psychological intervention methods, see list of psychotherapies.
<info> alternative therapy (two senses: a second choice among scientific therapies, or alternative medicine)
<info> bioidentical hormone replacement therapy (some scientific aspects, some pseudoscientific)
<info> Chinese food therapy (some scientific aspects, mostly prescientific)
<info> chiropractic therapy (some scientific aspects, some pseudoscientific)
<info> dietary therapy (various nonscientific and scientific forms)
<info> duct tape occlusion therapy (mechanism unknown but has had some scientific study)
<info> empiric therapy (two senses, one scientific, one not)
<info> Feldenkrais therapy (not entirely scientific, but empirical)
<info> gene therapy of the human retina
<info> halotherapy (mostly prescientific; see also mineral spa)
<info> herbal therapy (prescientific and pseudoscientific forms; compare phytotherapy)
<info> medical therapy in general contexts means therapy and within medical contexts often means specifically pharmacotherapy
<info> salt therapy (mostly prescientific; see also mineral spa)
<info> speleotherapy (mostly prescientific; see also mineral spa)
<info> sweat therapy (mostly prescientific; see also sauna and mineral spa)
<info> urine therapy (some scientific forms; various prescientific or pseudoscientific forms)
